codes.GOV-MANIFEST-001: Manifest is missing, unreadable or structurally invalid.
codes.GOV-SYNC-001: A managed governance file does not match its pinned SHA-256 digest.
codes.GOV-BOOT-001: A required target-repository file is missing.
codes.GOV-TICKET-001: Implementation changed without one active ticket.
codes.GOV-TICKET-002: More than one active ticket exists.
codes.GOV-TICKET-003: An active ticket is malformed or missing a required governance file.
codes.GOV-TICKET-004: Executable source, test or research content is stored in a ticket directory.
codes.GOV-INTENT-001: Implementation changed before the ticket entered an implementation state.
codes.GOV-INTENT-002: Ticket intent is missing or malformed.
codes.GOV-INTENT-003: Ticket intent was not committed before the first implementation commit.
codes.GOV-APPROVAL-001: Implementation lacks approval from a trusted external source.
codes.GOV-APPROVAL-002: Approval refers to a different ticket.
codes.GOV-SCOPE-001: A changed implementation path is outside the approved intent scope.
codes.GOV-OWNER-001: An untrusted actor changed a human-owned participant file.
codes.GOV-DOCKER-001: The required Docker runtime declaration is incomplete.
codes.GOV-STACK-001: The declared technology stack lacks its required project marker.
codes.GOV-SECRET-001: A changed file contains a probable secret assignment.
codes.GOV-PATH-001: A committed governance artifact contains a machine-local absolute path.
